data.body_html:
Spend a full day on the water with the whole family — jetski, snorkel and paddleboard all included on a private boat charter from Puerto Banús. This Marbella family boat day jetski snorkel paddleboard combo 2037 is designed for parents who want zero hassle and maximum fun. Depart on an Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax), both fully equipped with shade, bathroom and a licensed skipper who handles everything. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours and go up to €2,299 for 8 hours, with all drinks, snacks, fuel and VAT included. No hidden extras — just show up and enjoy.

What’s Included in the Family Combo

Every charter comes with a professional skipper, fuel, insurance, and Spanish IVA (21%). On board you’ll find unlimited water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava and light snacks. The combo adds a jetski (supervised), snorkel masks and fins, plus a paddleboard — all free of charge. The skipper knows the best spots for each activity: calm coves for snorkelling, open stretches for the jetski, and flat water for paddleboarding.

Boats Available for Your Family Day

We recommend the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 passengers) or the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 passengers). Both depart from Puerto Banús and are ideal for families: plenty of deck space, a small cabin with toilet, and a bimini top for shade. If you have a larger group, ask about our bigger yachts like the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) — pricing on request via WhatsApp.

Sample Itinerary: 8-Hour Family Day

  • 10:00 – Meet at Puerto Banús, welcome aboard with drinks
  • 10:30 – Depart towards Marbella coastline
  • 11:00 – First stop: snorkelling at Cala del Faro
  • 12:00 – Jetski session (supervised, 20–30 minutes)
  • 13:00 – Lunch at anchor near Cala Cortés (bring your own picnic or order from a beach club)
  • 14:30 – Paddleboard exploration along the cliffs
  • 16:00 – Relaxed cruise back to Puerto Banús
  • 17:00 – Disembark

The skipper can adjust timings and stops based on weather and your preferences.

Why Choose This Combo for Your Family

Marbella’s coastline offers sheltered coves, clear water and minimal swell — perfect for kids. The combo lets everyone try different activities without switching boats or paying extra. The jetski is supervised by the skipper, so even teenagers can have a go safely. Snorkelling spots like Cala del Faro have shallow, rocky bottoms with small fish. Paddleboarding is easy in the calm bays near Cabopino.

What to Bring

  • Swimwear, towel, sunscreen (high SPF, reef-safe recommended)
  • Sunglasses, hat, light jacket (wind can pick up)
  • Your own food if you prefer (fridge and cooler on board)
  • Camera or phone (waterproof case advised)
  • Extra drinks if you want something beyond the included beer, wine and soft drinks

Booking & Availability

To book your Marbella family boat day jetski snorkel paddleboard combo 2037, contact us via WhatsApp or email. We need your preferred date, group size and any special requests. A deposit secures the charter. Cancellations are possible up to 48 hours before departure. Check our Marbella boat rental page for other options.
